theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_fc_series_current
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n), ∑' r, (X r).mass ≠ ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, HasSum (fun r => X r ω) (Y ω)) ∧ Y.mass ≤ ∑' r, (X r).mass
